test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.Statement:The increasing use of artificial intelligence in healthcare can improve diagnosis accuracy but also raises concerns about data privacy.Assumptions:I. Artificial intelligence can improve medical diagnosis.II. Data privacy issues arise with technological advancement.III. Healthcare institutions fully support AI adoption.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit
All I, II and III are implicit

solution:
Assumption Analysis

I. Artificial intelligence can improve medical diagnosis.

 Valid — This is directly implied by “can improve diagnosis accuracy.”

II. Data privacy issues arise with technological advancement.

 Valid — The concern about data privacy presupposes that advanced technologies like AI can create such issues.

III. Healthcare institutions fully support AI adoption.

 Not necessary — The statement talks about increasing use and concerns; it does not require full institutional support.

Only I and II are implicit

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
